# lmw messages

Read and send messages

### Synopsis

List your latest conversations, newest first; unread ones are marked with a dot.
The subcommands show a conversation, send a message and mark one as read.

A conversation is named by the id shown in the list or by its address
(linkedin.com/messaging/thread/ID/).

```
lmw messages [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw messages
  lmw messages show 2-ZTU4MDlhMDYtM2QyOC00YjM2LWE4NGYtZWIyOGQyNjE0ZTA0XzEwMA==
  lmw messages send --to ada-lovelace --text "Hi Ada!"
```

### Options

```
      --folder string   folder: archive, inbox, other, requests, spam (default "inbox")
  -h, --help            help for messages
  -n, --limit int       number of conversations (1-50) (default 10)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
